stories.title: French family rescued after 16 hours adrift off Thai island
stories.summary: A French father and his two young sons were rescued after drifting 16 hours at sea off Koh Samui when their jet ski capsized. They were found exhausted but in stable condition and released from hospital after medical checks. Investigations are ongoing as the family may have travelled beyond the agreed rental area. A French family spent more than 16 hours floating at sea after their jet ski capsized off Thailand’s Koh Samui island before being rescued, a local official told AFP on Aug 15. The 50-year-old father and his two sons, aged five and seven, were taken to hospital for checks after their overnight ordeal but were discharged shortly afterwards, local government official Amorn Chomchoey said. “We found them exhausted after swallowing a lot of seawater,” he told AFP. “They were pale, especially the boys.” The father had rented a jet ski from a local operator on Koh Samui, a popular resort island in the Gulf of Thailand, at around 5pm local time on Aug 13. The operator became concerned when the family failed to return at the agreed time and alerted local rescuers and provincial authorities, Amorn said. They were found at around 10am on Aug 14. Investigators are looking into why the jet ski capsized after operating just over 15 minutes, Amorn’s secretary, who also works as a translator, told AFP. The father told officials he was an experienced jet ski driver, the secretary said.

stories.title: Bihar witnesses decline in number of major criminal cases of murder, dacoity, riots
stories.summary: Murder cases fell by 10.1%, dacoity by 31.32% & riots by 18.97%. More than 50,000 appointments made into police force in the past one and half years.
